column1: # The ordered llama.cpp patch series, and the one authority that states it.
# it, and build-llama-preset.sh reads it to decide what a build may declare, so a
# member added in one place and missed in another was a drift this file removes.
# `production` members apply in the order below onto the pinned commit and every
# promoted build compiles them. A `candidate` member is a backport under
# measurement: it applies after every production member, and a promotion moves
# its row to `production` together with the digest verify-llama-patch-series.sh
# pins for the file it rewrites.
